python -c "
import semver

# Verify all three functions are accessible as public API
print('cmd_bump:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_bump'))
print('cmd_check:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_check'))
print('cmd_compare:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_compare'))
print('createparser:', hasattr(semver, 'createparser'))
print('finalize_version:', hasattr(semver, 'finalize_version'))
print('process:', hasattr(semver, 'process'))

# Test all functions work correctly
print()
print('=== Testing cmd_bump ===')
print('major:', semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'major'))
print('minor:', semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'minor'))
print('patch:', semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'patch'))
print('prerelease:', semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3-rc.1', 'prerelease'))
print('build:', semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'build'))

print()
print('=== Testing cmd_check ===')
print('valid version:', semver.cmd_check('1.2.3'))
print('invalid version:', semver.cmd_check('not-a-version'))

print()
print('=== Testing cmd_compare ===')
print('-1:', semver.cmd_compare('1.0.0', '2.0.0'))
print('1:', semver.cmd_compare('2.0.0', '1.0.0'))
print('0:', semver.cmd_compare('2.0.0', '2.0.0'))

print()
print('=== Testing process with bump ===')
from argparse import Namespace
args = Namespace(which='bump', version='1.2.3', bump='major', parser=None)
print('process bump major:', semver.process(args))

print()
print('=== Testing process with compare ===')
args = Namespace(which='compare', version1='1.0.0', version2='2.0.0', parser=None)
print('process compare:', semver.process(args))

print()
print('=== Testing process with check (valid) ===')
args = Namespace(which='check', version='1.2.3', parser=None)
print('process check valid:', semver.process(args))

print()
print('All tests passed!')
"
